gpt.text:
Run the three “Next Commands” in order; they cover (1) module-level A/B selection, (2) full-system candidate eval, then (3) generating the next targeted fix plan.

## 1) Module autopilot (pick best module variants)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
**What it does:** runs the module AUB experiments defined in `module_registry.yaml`, then automatically promotes the best-performing variants into the registry/baseline (depending on how your tool is implemented).

**What to check after:**
- A report/artifact indicating which modules were selected
- Whether `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` (or referenced pointers) changed
- Any warnings about insufficient trials / high variance

## 2) System autopilot (end-to-end candidate evaluation)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
**What it does:** evaluates full-system candidates specified in `system_candidates.yaml` (often combinations of module selections + system-level toggles).

**What to check after:**
- Whether any candidate clearly beats the current champion on your primary metric(s)
- Whether results are “INCONCLUSIVE” due to overlapping CIs / too few samples
- Regressions on secondary metrics (latency, cost, safety, etc.) if tracked

## 3) Generate next fix plan (if still no clear winner)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
**What it does:** produces a prioritized “next fixes” markdown based on recent outcomes and what’s still underperforming.

**What to check after:**
- `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` for actionable items
- Whether it recommends more data collection vs. new candidate designs

---

### Interpreting the handoff snapshot you posted
- Current champion: `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`
- “Last PASS Candidate: (no PASS candidates)” means nothing has beaten the champion yet under your pass criteria.
- “INCONCLUSIVE Now: (none)” means nothing is currently mid-evaluation or stuck ambiguous right now.

If you paste the outputs (or links) from steps 1 and 2—especially the summary tables with means/mins and sample sizes—I can help decide whether to:
- accept a new champion,
- rerun with more trials,
- or adjust candidate generation / metrics.
